name: next-space-presses-in-a-burst-slide-through
description:
Two next-space presses in quick succession must slide First to Second to Third, with no pane vanishing mid-slide. A second jump that landed during the first glide used to lift the rail gap from the space it started on, so the half-shown Second pane turned into Third in one frame and Third just appeared.

A rAF sampler reads each rail pane's share of the sidebar width every frame. A pop is a pane that showed more than 40% of itself on one frame and nothing on the next. `burst` proves the second press landed mid-glide: Third came on screen before Second ever filled the sidebar.

actions.expression: (() => { if (window.__burst) { return 'armed'; } const s = {pops: [], frames: 0, panes: 0, secondFull: false, burst: false}; window.__burst = s; let prev = null; const tick = () => { const root = document.getElementById('atrium-root'); const w = root ? root.clientWidth : 0; const panes = root ? [...root.querySelectorAll('.railpane')] : []; s.panes = panes.length; const now = panes.map(p => { if (p.classList.contains('jumped') || !w) { return 0; } const b = p.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.max(0, Math.min(b.right, w) - Math.max(b.left, 0)) / w; }); if (prev && prev.length === now.length) { s.frames++; now.forEach((v, k) => { if (prev[k] > 0.4 && v === 0) { s.pops.push(k + ':' + prev[k].toFixed(2)); } }); } if (now[2] > 0.99) { s.secondFull = true; } if (now[3] > 0.01 && !s.secondFull) { s.burst = true; } prev = now; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); return 'armed'; })()
actions.note: Pane 0 is the Overview, so First, Second and Third are panes 1, 2 and 3.
One cgevent process. Two `key` actions arrive after the first glide has landed.

actions.expression: (() => { const s = window.__burst; return 'pops=' + s.pops.join(',') + ' burst=' + s.burst + ' sampled=' + (s.frames > 30) + ' panes=' + s.panes; })()

assertions.desc: No pane vanished mid-slide, and the second press landed during the first glide.
